purpose: Localize native functional sensitivity to commuting initial updates across complete recurrent/convolution and historical KV paths, after the conventional augmentation baseline.
selection: Every original validation example, in the same registered order. No selection by native error, augmentation outcome, model score or rescue ability.
generation: Unrestricted greedy generation with the existing 12-token/newline/EOS rule. Gold-only teacher scoring provides NLL, never a forced-choice accuracy or an oracle KV mask.
gate: Require independently audited completion of all four fixed-budget augmented controllers in both development orders, plus the original native/full order references; verify the augmentation plan digest. No new path-probe model inference before that gate.
requirements: Reuse exactly the registered semantic cases and initial-record derangements. Current/initial truth, questions, query token IDs and absolute query positions must match between origins.

Compute complete natural prefix caches for both orders with full prefix prefill. Explicitly split at the ledger/question boundary for every primary natural and mixed readout. Reuse old full-prefill readouts only as separately labeled calibration comparisons; full and cached BF16 paths need not have identical answers or losses.

Use the existing matched-position transplant helper. Swap all eighteen recurrent matrices together with complete convolution state and required initialized/bookkeeping fields, or all six attention KV pairs. Fixed group set is all six quartets; no layer selection or learned repair.

All-path transplants must reproduce donor cache tensors, and self transplants must reproduce the recipient. Source caches must stay bitwise unchanged after every probe; each query/scoring/generation branch gets an isolated fork.

On the lexicographically first/last query keys, replay self and all-path donor readouts and require matching unrestricted generation and answer NLL within 1e-5. Observe actual nonzero historical attention at all six layers in all four cached conditions; expect cached rather than full-prefill observer calls.

Report all four full-cohort functional summaries and paired rescues/regressions, stable unchanged facts and ADD-separated targets. Report the full-vs-cached natural difference before attributing any cross-path rescue to recurrent or KV effects.

Report gold-NLL recurrent-source and KV-source contrasts and their difference-in-differences as descriptive counterfactual effects, with paired example identities. Do not treat mixed caches as natural model accuracy or a trained architecture.
Freeze every parameter, record source/model/package identities, and retain all 1728 raw free generations and NLLs. No retraining, extra capacity, evidence masks or post-result condition selection.
interpretation: Reused-validation pathway diagnostic, not untouched confirmation. Natural prefix orders are semantically equivalent but their representations differ; mixed caches can be out of distribution and need not correspond to a realizable prefix. Functional rescue does not prove unique storage, ordinary write damage, or a new semantic interface. No absence-of-information claim from a failed transplant.
